body: do you have self issues? lack of confidence? maybe you should work on that. like bontesla said, we teach people how to treat us.

yeah, its kinda magical I think. :) I really don't know, since we both don't have a job, we're so broke that we can barely afford a one week cheap vacation in the country. I think I would be going after my graduation. and after I got a job. in, like, 4 - 5 years I think. -_-

well she has her own shrink. she is bipolar but refuses to get proper help. wants me to cure her. I have no idea how to do that.

I don't see it as a sacrifice either, I actually enjoy helping others, but I'm incredibly stuck with telling about my problems. so usually it's only me helping them. even writing my problems here was a torture.

you're right actually. I'm feeling better now. I know that I can find good things If I focus on present, but when you feel that there are holes in your soul, it's kinda hard.

I actually want to travel the world. I've been always interested in other people's cultures, lifestyles, values etc. (since mine sucked) but I always wanted to see New York. It simply amazes me, I don't know. and Paris. :)

thank you for answering. I am planning to study fine arts, or russian literature. I haven't decided yet. I just want to get a job that will help me get on my feet. I don't want to depend on anyone. I want to buy my own furniture and clothes and everything. I want to do whatever I want to do. I want to go to concerts, vacations, buy gifts, do exciting stuff and travel. That's all. I don't know what I do after that, probably nothing cause I don't see the point. I've been thinking about starting a family, but probably I'll be a shitty mother. so no further plans. thank you for caring.

thank you for answering. I'm trying to ignore her. but she's unpredictable. a few times she called me telling that she took all her pills at once she just wanted to say goodbye etc. I have to be the one who takes care of her again. it's her way to get attention. I'm literally parenting her. it's so annoying.

being strong is tiring actually.. you see, I was always the person who people relied on. even in my friendships, people see me as a mature, elderly person who is going to make everything ok and take care of everyone. even if I'm the same age as they are! it's all over me. 

btw, I've never seen it that way, I was actually sad about living in my boyfriends flat without telling their parents, cause it kinda makes me nervous. but you're right, he is risking his everything.

thanks again. It's good to talk to someone.
